item.tib: gsas mkhar gsang ba'i rgyud rgya che rol pa las rin po che tshe yi sgrub pa
item.coloph: de ltar 'chi med tshe sgrub zhes bya ba/ gsang sngags gsang ba'i rgyud las rgya che rol pa'i cha lag gsas mkhar rab 'byams gsang ba'i yang thig 'chi med tshe yi sgrub pa rdzogs so/ zhes khyung rin po che lha dbang sku mched kyis tshe yi sgrub pa zhig gsungs te rten 'brel che ba'i stabs su sprang po bdag gis 'khrul ba'i skabs su/ sprin dkar lang ling Ína bun gyi nang du/ tshe bum mi lus tsam zhig gda' spang (pang) pas mi theg pa zhig 'dug bdag ni blor song ste/ tshe chu de skya phyu ru ru khol byung*/ de tshe bdag gzhan kun la byin bsam nas tshe bum la 'tham yod par/ shar phyogs nas mi sdug pa'i 'tshub ma nag po zhig byung ste/ mi dang mi ma yin sogs mang por 'tshogs pa'i snang ba yod par/ kha gsum tsam gyi tsho gcig la them ma thub ste/ phyi nas byugs pa dang gtor snang byung*/ zhes nyams snang lta bu dang mthun par/ cung tsam rang bzos bslad nas lhan thabs tshul du bsgrigs pa 'dis kyang 'di spyod pa yi bon gshen thams cad 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub thob nas/ mthar thug tshe'i rig 'dzin rnams dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig/
